text:
lena: Heads-up: Beta customer CareNote asked for an Optimize autosuggest pilot — wants batching + cache suggestions surfaced in Console, plus eval-based alerts. They want pilot within 6 weeks for note-extraction flows.

omar: 6 weeks tight. Propose MLP: (1) rule-based batching by token-length, (2) simple prefix/KV cache toggles with default TTLs, (3) read-only eval alerts to Console (no automated rollbacks). Defer quantization and ML-driven controllers.

kevin: Ops constraints: runs on Dedicated mixed GPUs. Batching must keep p95 under 340ms and p99 under 700ms. We'll surface per-route hit-rate, batch-size distribution, and eval-alert counts.

lena: Customer acceptance: p95 < 340ms, and alert if our summary metric drops >3% vs baseline for 2 windows of 500 requests. Ask them for sample traffic + 1k labeled eval or permission for sentinel probes.

omar: Quick config sketch: {"optimize": {"batching": {"buckets": [64,256,1024],"max_batch": [12,6,3],"latency_cap_ms": 340},"cache": {"prefix_ttl_s": 30,"kv_mode": "light"}}}

kevin: infra-bot:precheck shows we need a small metrics schema tag `optimize_v0`. I'll open INF-5320. ETA 4d.

ops-bot: ticket INF-5320 created.

maria: Risks: noisy alerts from small eval sets and traffic mismatch. Mitigate by requiring human confirmation on alerts and a cooldown window.

lena: Action items: (1) lena -> request traffic_profile.csv + eval_labels.csv from CareNote; (2) omar -> PR for heuristic batching; (3) kevin -> INF-5320 + reserve Dedicated slice; (4) maria -> prepare runbook stub.

lena: We'll ship MLP (6 weeks) with read-only alerts and recommendation export. Phase 2 (post-pilot) will add UI guidance, quant recs, and ML controller. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
